defs.def: the way in which two people or things are not like each other; the way in which sb/sth has changed 差别；差异；不同（之处）；变化（之处）

ex.s: “The food you have available makes a huge difference.
ex.t: 你手头有什么食物，会产生巨大的影响。

ex.s: The differences between print and digital reading results are partly related to paper’s physical properties.
ex.t: 印刷和数字阅读结果之间的差异部分与纸张的物理特性有关。

ex.s: One such study published in 2023 aimed to see if dogs can tell the difference between humans who are “unwilling” or “unable” to give them a treat.
ex.t: 2023年发表的一项此类研究旨在看看狗能否区分人类中'不愿意'或'不能'给它们零食的人。

ex.s: For Cruse, what started out as a way to kill time has now developed into a way to make a difference in the heart of a child.
ex.t: 对克鲁斯来说，最初打发时间的方式，如今已变成在孩子心灵中产生积极影响的方式。

ex.s: The International Olympic Committee(IOC)Young Leaders programme empowers talents to make a positive difference in their communities through sport.
ex.t: 国际奥委会（IOC）青年领袖项目赋能人才通过体育在社区产生积极影响。

ex.s: Just accept your differences and learn to work with each other.
ex.t: 接受你们的差异，学会彼此合作。

ex.s: His presentation not only awed and inspired me, but also helped emerge an inner desire to make a difference in the world.
ex.t: 他的演讲不仅让我惊叹和受到启发，还帮助唤起一种想在世界有所作为的内在渴望。

ex.s: To observe their differences.
ex.t: 观察它们的不同之处。

ex.s: They see gender differences earlier than boys.
ex.t: 她们比男孩更早看到性别差异。

ex.s: But does one plastic straw or cup really make a difference?
ex.t: 但一根塑料吸管或一个塑料杯真的有影响吗？

ex.s: The differences between most of the groups were statistically insignificant; however,the participants in the 70 decibels group—those exposed to a level of noise similar to background chatter in a coffee shop-significantly outperformed the other groups.
ex.t: 大多数组之间的差异在统计上不显著；然而，70分贝组的参与者——那些暴露在类似咖啡店背景闲谈噪音水平下的人——明显优于其他组。

ex.s: "Just five more minutes outdoors can make a difference," David Bond says.
ex.t: “只要在户外再多五分钟就能带来改变，”大卫·邦德说。

ex.s: There were considerable differences.
ex.t: 然后他们比较了这些样本。

ex.s: Kevin Balke, a research engineer at the Texas A&M University Transportation Institute, says that while smart lights can be particularly beneficial for some cities, others are so jammed that only a sharp reduction in the number of cars on the road will make a meaningful difference.
ex.t: 德克萨斯A&M大学交通研究所的研究工程师凯文·巴尔克(Kevin Balke)表示，虽然智能灯对一些城市特别有利，但另一些城市却卡住了，只有急剧减少路上的汽车数量才能产生有意义的变化。

ex.s: For Parry, the reward is knowing he hopefully made a difference in a child's life, and except for his drawings on bandages, "they can go on and live their lives and never know I was in it,” he said.
ex.t: 对帕里来说，回报在于知道自己或许改变了一个孩子的人生，而且除了他在绷带上的画，他说“他们可以继续生活，永远不知道我曾经在其中”。

ex.s: To make a difference in his dull medical career.
ex.t: 为了让他单调的行医生涯有所不同。

ex.s: After years of observing human nature, I have decided that two qualities make the difference between men of great achievement and men of average performance curioscy and discontent.
ex.t: 经过多年对人性的观察，我已认定有两种品质决定了成就卓著者与表现平庸者之间的差别：好奇与不满。

ex.s: The differences between weak and strong links in food webs．
ex.t: D．食物网中弱链接与强链接之间的差异。

ex.s: I enjoyed studying difference kings of cars and planes, playing pop music, and collecting the late music albums.
ex.t: 我喜欢研究不同种类的汽车和飞机，演奏流行音乐，收集最新的音乐专辑。

ex.s: He really had made a difference for these children.
ex.t: 他确实给这些孩子带来了改变。

ex.s: Talk about their similarities and differences.
ex.t: 谈论它们的相似之处和不同之处。

ex.s: Darwin noticed that there was a difference between the finches on each of the islands.
ex.t: 达尔文注意到每个岛上的雀鸟之间都存在差异。

ex.s: Differences: • Macquarie is an island, while Shennongjia is a mountainous area.
ex.t: 不同点：麦夸里是一个岛屿，而神农架是山区。

ex.s: But the study was small and needs to be repeated with far larger groups of people to determine exactly which aspects of an exercise routine make the biggest difference.
ex.t: 但这项研究规模小，需要用大得多的人群重复，以确切确定锻炼计划的哪些方面影响最大。

defs.def: the amount that sth is greater or smaller than sth else 差；差额

ex.s: He suggested I think about the difference between endings that I wanted for the characters and endings that were right for the characters, endings that satisfied the story even if they didn’t have a traditionally positive outcome.
ex.t: 他建议我思考：我想要的结局和适合角色的结局之间的区别——那些让故事圆满的结局，即便不是传统意义上的美满结局。

ex.s: In the beginning，I dared myself to make a difference in the life of another person．Now that our project is over，I realize that I have affected not only one life，but ten．With our efforts，ten young boys and girls will now be able to further their education．
ex.t: 一开始我鼓起勇气想要改变另一个人的生活。现在我们的项目结束了，我意识到我影响的不只是一个生命，而是十个。通过我们的努力，十个年轻人现在将能够继续接受教育。

ex.s: You could not take back a book to the library on the same day you’d taken it out; it made no difference to her that you’d read every word in it and needed another to start.
ex.t: 你不能在借书当天就把书还回图书馆；即便你把里面每个字都读了、需要另一本开始读，对她来说也没区别。

ex.s: The friendship that grew out of the experience of making that film and The Sting four years later had its root in the fact that although there was an age difference, we both came from a tradition of theater and live TV.
ex.t: 从拍摄那部电影以及四年后拍摄《骗中骗》的经历中发展出来的友谊，其根源在于这样一个事实：尽管我们有年龄差距，但我们都来自戏剧和现场电视的传统。

ex.s: The friendship that grew out of the experience of making that film and The Sting four years later had its root in the fact that although there was an age difference, we both came from a tradition of theater and live TV.
ex.t: 从拍摄那部电影以及四年后拍摄《骗中骗》的经历中发展出来的友谊，其根源在于这样一个事实：尽管我们有年龄差距，但我们都来自戏剧和现场电视的传统。

defs.def: a disagreement between people 意见分歧；不和

ex.s: There’s a crucial difference between failing at the right thing and persisting at the wrong one.
ex.t: 在正确的事上失败，与在错误的事上坚持，二者有着关键的区别。

ex.s: Before birth, babies can tell the difference between loud sounds and voices.
ex.t: 但规模本身并不是罪过。

ex.s: I knew it was the difference between life and death.” says Taylor.
ex.t: 我知道那是生与死的区别，'Taylor 说。
